name: How long does the custom shelving installation process take?

mainEntity.name: How long does the custom shelving installation process take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of custom shelving installation varies based on the complexity and size of the project. A small, straightforward installation might be completed in a single day, while larger, more intricate designs involving multiple rooms or custom finishes could take several days to a week. Our process typically starts with an initial consultation, followed by design and material selection, then fabrication, and finally on-site installation. We provide a detailed timeline after understanding your specific project requirements during the initial design phase, aiming to minimize disruption to your home in Meridian.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installation time varies by project complexity and size, from one day for simple shelves to several days for intricate designs. We provide a detailed timeline after initial consultation and design.
